notes: Encoded ONLY from Sync's own page text. The page states these styles were utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems; the shipped styles below coincide with the Lochinvar file's, but each is justified from this page's own text and examples independently, and no content is imported from any other page. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both letter-chart-only, shape 2 letters + 7 digits) and page Style 7 (5Y013 / 6S1064 / 11AA0365: year = 2nd or 2nd & 3rd letters, chart-only, variable forms) — no year encodable from text. Page Styles 3, 4, 5, 6 ship YEAR-ONLY: year digits text-verified, month = 1st letter chart-only. Shape-collision check: every shipped pattern is disjoint from both held shapes (held Style 1 is letter-led 9 characters; held Style 7 forms are digit-led with letters at position 1 or 2-3 and lengths 5, 6, 8) — verified per style in style notes. Month-letter charts for styles 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 go to the image pass.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Disjoint from held Style 1 (letter-led) and held Style 7 (letter at position 1 or 2-3, lengths 5/6/8).
Year = 1st & 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '93'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. Disjoint from held Style 1 (9 characters) and held Style 7 (digit-led, lengths 5/6/8).
Year = 1st & 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '07'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. Disjoint from held styles (all shorter, and held Style 7 forms are digit-led).

styles.notes: Year = 1st & 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '93'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
